note: Per-round ledger of this target's review history. The commit/merge gate keys freshness on the sibling record (<key>.json) — a fresh review of the exact reviewed bytes — but --record now refuses to file a record unless this ledger's last round reviewed those same bytes, so a record can never be filed for content the ledger never saw. This file is the history the record itself cannot carry: what each round found, what was fixed, what was refuted by execution. Rounds are appended in order; a header key already present is never rewritten or dropped by a later append.

findings_fixed: Descriptor and pre-write symlink false grants (all six; found independently while the round ran and confirmed in real bash): a write to a user descriptor or dev-fd path counts as written somewhere unknown, and any other command in the line that names a written file makes its other file arguments aliases. Unresolved write target (deepseek): a target that cannot be resolved through the line's own assignments counts as written somewhere unknown. Question B false deny (all six; three called it unacceptable): the blanket any-dollar-or-glob reader rule is replaced — a dollar variable resolves through the line's own assignments and an environment variable the line never set is not a match; a glob is matched against the written names; only a command substitution or backtick matches blanket.
rounds.notes: All 6 responding reviewers returned verdicts. Question B split three to three on acceptability; resolved in favour of removing the false deny, since the replacement closes the same false grants by resolution instead of by blanket suspicion.
